verdict_rule: PASS iff delta_r2 >= 0.03 on the DOI holdout
caveats: One seed. The paired folds are identical, but the run-to-run SD of this model is not characterised on this split.

The DOI split here is GroupKFold(5) on doi, matching the msrs_generalization protocol but not identical to msrs_dmpnn_surface's fragment/canonical splits, so these R2 values are not comparable to that artifact's.

A Cp ring contributes several carbanion atoms; the builder caps donors at the coordination number, so an eta-5 ring consumes up to 5 of the 6 slots. That over-counts hapticity and is a known simplification.
